scripts.validate:security: node -e "console.log('\x1b[33m[validate]\x1b[0m Running npm audit checks (informational, mirrors CI non-blocking behavior)...')" && npm audit --audit-level=high || true && npm audit --prefix server --audit-level=high || true && npm audit --prefix client --audit-level=high || true
scripts.validate: npm run validate:banner && npm run format:check && npm run validate:server && npm run validate:client && npm run validate:security
scripts.validate:changed: node -e "const {execSync}=require('node:child_process');const fs=execSync('git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim().split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);const run=(cmd)=>execSync(cmd,{stdio:'inherit'});const has=(re)=>fs.some(f=>re.test(f));console.log('\x1b[36m[validate:changed]\x1b[0m Changed files:',fs.length);if(fs.length===0){console.log('No changes detected.');process.exit(0);}if(has(/\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|css|html|json|md|yml|yaml)$/)||has(/^\.github\/workflows\//)){run('npm run format:check');}if(has(/^server\//)||has(/^\.github\/workflows\//)){run('npm run validate:server');}if(has(/^client\//)||has(/^\.github\/workflows\//)){run('npm run validate:client');}run('npm run validate:security');"
